title: Hold a petroleum title to explore for or produce petroleum
what: Explore for or recover petroleum onshore only under an exploration permit, retention licence or production licence granted by the Minister.

sources.title: Petroleum Act 1984 (NT)
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if: (a) the person intentionally engages in conduct; and (b) the conduct is part of carrying out an activity for which an exploration permit, retention licence or production licence is required

sources.title: Petroleum Act 1984 (NT)
sources.locator: s 20(3), words naming the body (found 23 Nov 2026) (current reprint)
sources.quote: The Minister must then determine whether to grant the exploration permit in respect of some or all of the blocks (including part or parts of a block) to which the application relates or refuse to grant the exploration permit.
